forbidden.title: Ntabwo wemerewe kubona aya makuru
forbidden.description: Uruhare rwawe rw'igerageza ntirwemerewe kubona ibi. Nta makuru y'iyi paji yafunguwe, kandi iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'igenzura cy'igerageza.

unknownScope.title: Ntibyabonetse
unknownScope.description: Nta karere cyangwa ikigo nderabuzima gifite iyi nomero mu makuru y'igerageza.
